admission.justification: Trimming vendored whitespace breaks recorded distribution hashes and allowing Git to report it blocks resolving a sync even when the preserved fixture is correct.

applicability: Git whitespace checks on the checked-in Paseo server fixtures used by the plugin.
conditions: The fixture files preserve the upstream distribution bytes.
Staged sync validation calls Git's whitespace check.
exclusions: Generated dashboard chunks and unrelated repository files.
Fixture manifest validation and other sync checks.

evidence: W8 Git 2.55.0 empty-tree fixture comparison reproduces two W7 reports and zero W8 reports, with the fixture subtree object unchanged.

statement: Git excludes the plug-in's vendored Paseo fixtures from whitespace checking so an upstream whitespace finding cannot block staged sync validation on those byte-preserved copies.
